mentions.name: Unmute Party
mentions.description: This is a browser-based platform of multiplayer party games for remote teams, played together during a Zoom or Teams call. Servers are EU-only for now with US servers planned for the next week; most features are free, while the paid tiers aren't working yet and can be unlocked with a promo code.
mentions.source_excerpt: Most recent project is  Unmute Party (https://unmuteparty.com) - multiplayer party games for remote teams, played in the browser during a Zoom or Teams call. The server is EU-only for now, and I plan to add US servers next week. Most of it is free, the paid tiers aren't even working yet.
mentions.author: ribice
